exposure: Women with a spontaneous vaginal birth subsequent to a caesarean
Women with only vaginal births who had experienced one or more instrumental vaginal births
Women with only spontaneous vaginal births
cohort: 43,639 mothers from the Danish National Birth Cohort (1996-2002)
finding: Vaginal birth, even after caesarean section, was associated with fewer long-term sexual problems compared to caesarean section alone.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with increased odds of sexual problems compared to spontaneous vaginal birth, while vaginal birth after caesarean was not associated with increased odds of sexual problems.
